capabilities: Move a chapter or scene together with all its descendants to a new parent and position
Preview the complete proposed order next to the current order before applying
Create a .md.bak source backup and apply a checked index update with conflict detection
Stage several moves in one combined preview (Pro)
Save and restore named manuscript orders (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core moves are free; multiple moves per preview, named orders, and checked restore require a $5/month or one-time $15 GitHub Sponsors sponsorship plus GitHub sign-in (device flow, read:user scope only, token stored via Obsidian secret storage). Pro works offline up to 14 days after a check. Updates open a What's new tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (disable in Settings); no backup-disable setting exists. Not tested on mobile, Linux, live GitHub payments, or multi-device sync.
intentEvidence: Move a chapter and its child scenes together in a Longform manuscript index.
problem: In a Longform manuscript index the child scene array follows the parent scene's name, so moving the name alone can leave scenes under the wrong chapter.

relations.evidence: Longform need not be enabled to read the index, but the file must use its nested scene-array format.
Sign in uses the GitHub device flow.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Manuscript index tool that moves a Longform chapter and its nested child scenes together in one previewed, backed-up edit.
